title: THE PENDULUM · HINGE LADDER
why: Yesterday loaded chest, back and arms, so today is hips and hamstrings: heavy swings, snatches and jerks climbing a 6-rung ladder, with a run leg that grows every rung. Six rungs is the number the last ladder owed.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B · ankles / knees / hips / shoulders

blocks.title: THE PENDULUM · 6 RUNGS
blocks.meta: ASCENDING LADDER · 6 RUNGS · 6 stations + 1 run leg per rung · cap 26:00 · 60 lb, 52 lb DB, 2×45
blocks.format: One clock. Rung N: every station at its rung-N reps, in order, then the run leg. Reps climb each rung. Score = rungs finished inside 26:00, then the time. Log rungs, time, slowest station and RPE.
blocks.workRest: RUN LEG after station 6, every rung: flat, 8.5 mph, time = rung × 15 s (0:15 / 0:30 / 0:45 / 1:00 / 1:15 / 1:30). Rung 6 leg at 9.0.

items.name: 1 · Hardstyle swing 60 lb · 2/4/6/8/10/12
items.detail: two hands, snap the hips, bell floats to chest height

items.name: 2 · Half snatch 52 lb · 1/2/3/4/5/6 per side
items.detail: snatch to lockout, lower to the rack, drop from the rack into the next rep

items.name: 3 · Double jerk 2×45 · 1/2/3/4/5/6
items.detail: from the rack, bend the knees, drive, catch under with soft knees, stand to lockout

items.name: 4 · Cross-body single-leg deadlift 52 lb · 1/2/3/4/5/6 per side
items.detail: DB in the hand opposite the standing leg, reach to the shin, hips square

items.name: 5 · Hip thrust 60 lb · 2/4/6/8/10/12
items.detail: shoulders on the bench, bell on the hips, 2-count squeeze at the top

items.name: 6 · Squat jump · 2/4/6/8/10/12
items.detail: bodyweight, land quiet, reset each rep

blocks.noteGreen: Green (today): all 6 rungs inside 26:00. Stretch: under 23:00.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 5 rungs, swings and hip thrusts with the 52, run legs at 8.0.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · drag-through + Copenhagen hold + L-sit · straight through

items.name: Kettlebell drag-through 35 lb ×10/side
items.detail: hands and toes, arms straight, drag the bell under you hand to hand, hips do not turn

items.name: Copenhagen hold off the bench 20s/side
items.detail: top foot on the bench, bottom knee bent, hips high

items.name: L-sit on the floor 15s
items.detail: hands by the hips, legs straight, or one leg at a time
